attributes.context: The chunk also includes Section 11, which states that Schedule A contains the classifications, wage rates, and special conditions that supplement the agreement, and Section 10, which refers to Section 7 grievance and arbitration procedures, both of which are relevant to understanding the extracted classification and wage-rate dispute process.

extraction_text: If the Employer hereafter establishes any new or substantially changed job classification or work operation, it will give as much notice thereof to the Unions as is possible. The question of proper classification and wage rate shall be negotiated with the Employer and the affected Union. If not resolved by the parties either party may request arbitration of the proper classification and rate under the procedures set forth in Section 7, preceding. Pending resolution of the problem by arbitration, the Employer may install the new or substantially changed classification or work operation at the rate which it has proposed. In the event any higher rate is agreed upon by the parties or awarded after arbitration, it shall be effective retroactively as of the date the classification or operation was installed.
